content: प्रेर् {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To set in motion, move. .²2 To push or urge on, propel, impel, send forth; यात्रायै प्रेरयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत् <ls>R. 4. 24</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²3 To incite, instigate, set on. .²4 To cast, direct (as eyes); नयने यत् प्रेरयन्त्या तया <ls>Ś. 2. 2</ls>. .²5 To throw, hurl. .²6 To send forth, despatch. .²7 To utter. .²8 To ask.
